title: Cosplay Character Photography (Flux)
description: Photorealistic cosplay photography for costume designer portfolios, convention social media, and fandom content.

prompt.main: cosplay character of wonder woman in full golden armor, detailed tiara and bullet-deflecting bracelets, holding lasso of truth, dramatic action pose mid-leap, soft diffused studio lighting, detailed leather and metal textures, comic con photo shoot quality
prompt.negative: cartoon, anime, casual, low effort costume

explained.why: Higher guidance for detailed costume rendering.

tutorial.intro: Cosplay = specific character + detailed costume pieces + "comic con photo shoot" + named materials. Specificity = authenticity.
steps: Character: cosplay character of wonder woman in full golden armor 鈥?name the character + armor color.
Details: detailed tiara and bullet-deflecting bracelets, holding lasso of truth 鈥?three named accessories.
Pose: dramatic action pose mid-leap 鈥?action pose shows off costume.
Light: soft diffused studio lighting 鈥?even light for costume detail.
Materials: detailed leather and metal textures 鈥?material specification.
Reference: comic con photo shoot quality 鈥?convention standard.
tutorial.tips: Name the specific character + 3+ specific accessories. Generic "superhero" gets you 1000 stock results.

crossModel.midjourney: MJ v6.1: "wonder woman cosplay, golden armor, lasso --ar 2:3 --v 6.1 --s 600".
crossModel.dall_e: DALL-E 3: "A Wonder Woman cosplay with golden armor, tiara, bracelets, and lasso of truth, comic con photo shoot".

faq.q: Why does my costume look like Halloween?
faq.a: You forgot specific accessories + "comic con photo shoot". Convention quality = named items + reference.

faq.q: How to make the costume look premium?
faq.a: Name materials (leather, metal, silk) + 3+ specific items. Detail = premium cosplay.
2:3 vertical + character name + action pose. Reads as "cosplay" instantly.
